key: {learning} learning · {known} known
from: {learning} dipelajari · {known} dikuasai
to: {learning} sedang dipelajari · {known} dikuasai
why: Inconsistent with the term sheet for 'Learning' ('Sedang dipelajari').

key: {minutes} minutes of real Japanese — Kizuki picked new clips for you.
from: Belajar bahasa Jepang langsung dari video selama {minutes} menit — Kizuki sudah memilih klip baru untuk kamu.
to: {minutes} menit bahasa Jepang asli — Kizuki sudah memilih klip baru untuk kamu.
why: The current translation is unnecessarily wordy and adds phrases not present in the original.

key: A quick [hello] before you start
from: [Sapaan] singkat sebelum kamu mulai
to: [Halo] singkat sebelum kamu mulai
why: Translating 'hello' to 'Halo' fits the context better than the formal 'Sapaan' (greeting).

key: Aug
from: Agu
to: Agt
why: The standard Indonesian abbreviation for Agustus is 'Agt'.

key: Create a free account from Profile → Save your progress, then sign in with the same account on the new phone. Your words, reviews and streak sync automatically.
from: Buat akun gratis lewat Profil → Simpan progresmu, lalu masuk dengan akun yang sama di ponsel baru. Kata, latihan, dan jumlah hari belajar beruntun kamu akan tersinkron otomatis.
to: Buat akun gratis lewat Profil → Simpan progresmu, lalu masuk dengan akun yang sama di ponsel baru. Kata, pengulangan, dan hari berturut-turut kamu tersinkron otomatis.
why: Inconsistent with the term sheet for 'Streak' (Hari berturut-turut).

key: Go to the feed
from: Buka feed
to: Buka Beranda
why: Term sheet defines 'Feed' as 'Beranda'.

key: Keep your streak alive 🔥
from: Jaga streak kamu tetap aktif 🔥
to: Jaga hari berturut-turut kamu tetap aktif 🔥
why: "Streak" must be translated as "Hari berturut-turut" according to the term sheet.

key: Keep your words, streak and reviews safe on every device.
from: Pastikan kata, streak, dan progres pengulangan kamu tetap aman di semua perangkat.
to: Pastikan kata, hari berturut-turut, dan progres pengulangan kamu tetap aman di semua perangkat.
why: The term "streak" must be consistent with the term sheet translation "Hari berturut-turut".

key: Kizuki is busy right now — try again in a moment.
from: Kizuki sedang sibuk — coba lagi sebentar, ya.
to: Kizuki sedang sibuk — coba beberapa saat lagi.
why: "Coba lagi sebentar" is unnatural in Indonesian; "coba beberapa saat lagi" is the correct idiomatic phrasing.

key: Kizuki will show you around on the feed.
from: Kizuki akan memandu kamu menjelajahi feed.
to: Kizuki akan memandu kamu menjelajahi Beranda.
why: The term "feed" must be translated as "Beranda" according to the term sheet.

key: Learn Japanese from real clips.
from: Belajar bahasa Jepang dari cuplikan video autentik.
to: Belajar bahasa Jepang dari klip asli.
why: 'klip asli' is punchier and matches 'real clips' better for an app interface than 'cuplikan video autentik'.

key: Learners with reminders on are far more likely to keep their streak.
from: Pelajar yang mengaktifkan pengingat jauh lebih mungkin mempertahankan streak mereka.
to: Pelajar yang mengaktifkan pengingat jauh lebih mungkin mempertahankan hari berturut-turut mereka.
why: Term sheet defines 'Streak' as 'Hari berturut-turut'.

key: Mark remaining {n} word as known
from: Tandai {n} kata tersisa sebagai sudah tahu
to: Tandai {n} kata tersisa sebagai dikuasai
why: Term sheet defines 'Known' as 'Dikuasai'.

key: Mark remaining {n} words as known
from: Tandai {n} kata tersisa sebagai sudah tahu
to: Tandai {n} kata tersisa sebagai dikuasai
why: Term sheet defines 'Known' as 'Dikuasai'.

key: No line · known word
from: Tanpa garis bawah · kata yang sudah dikenal
to: Tanpa garis bawah · kata dikuasai
why: Term sheet defines 'Known' as 'Dikuasai'.

key: One short clip saves your streak today.
from: Cukup satu klip pendek untuk menjaga rentetan belajarmu hari ini.
to: Cukup satu klip pendek untuk menjaga streak kamu hari ini.
why: Maintains consistency by using 'streak' as in other strings, instead of 'rentetan belajarmu'.

key: Open Kizuki → Profile → Settings → Delete account. This permanently deletes your account, saved words, reviews, streak and cloud progress.
from: Buka Kizuki → Profil → Pengaturan → Hapus akun. Akun, kata tersimpan, riwayat ulasan, streak, dan progres kamu di cloud akan dihapus permanen.
to: Buka Kizuki → Profil → Pengaturan → Hapus akun. Akun, kata tersimpan, latihan ulang, streak, dan progres kamu di cloud akan dihapus permanen.
why: In Indonesian, 'ulasan' means app/product reviews; flashcard reviews are better translated as 'latihan ulang' or 'pengulangan'.

key: Save words I tap
from: Simpan kata yang saya ketuk
to: Simpan kata yang aku ketuk
why: The app uses a casual tone with 'kamu', so the first-person pronoun should be 'aku' rather than the formal 'saya'.

key: Sign in with your Premium account to ask about this line. Your words and streak sync too.
from: Masuk dengan akun Premium kamu untuk bertanya tentang kalimat ini. Kata tersimpan dan catatan hari belajar berturut-turut kamu juga akan disinkronkan.
to: Masuk dengan akun Premium kamu untuk bertanya tentang kalimat ini. Kata dan hari berturut-turut kamu juga akan disinkronkan.
why: Updated to strictly match the term sheet for 'Words' (Kata) and 'Streak' (Hari berturut-turut).

key: Smart reviews with the original audio
from: Ulasan pintar dengan audio asli
to: Pengulangan pintar dengan audio asli
why: Used 'Pengulangan' instead of 'Ulasan' for 'reviews' to match the spaced repetition context and 'Review my words' (Ulangi kosakataku).

key: Smart reviews with the original clip audio
from: Ulasan pintar dengan audio klip asli
to: Pengulangan pintar dengan audio klip asli
why: Changed 'Ulasan' to 'Pengulangan' to be consistent with the context of flashcard reviews.

key: Streaks, goals and progress stats
from: Hari belajar berturut-turut, target, dan statistik kemajuan
to: Hari berturut-turut, target, dan statistik kemajuan
why: Adjusted to exactly match the term sheet for 'Streak' (Hari berturut-turut).

key: Ten minutes a day on the train and my listening is way better.
from: Sepuluh menit sehari di kereta, kemampuan menyimak saya jadi jauh lebih baik.
to: Sepuluh menit sehari di kereta, kemampuan menyimakku jadi jauh lebih baik.
why: Use 'aku' or its clitic form '-ku' for the first person since the app uses the casual 'kamu' for the user; 'saya' is too formal.

key: They'll show up here, ready to review.
from: Kata-kata itu akan muncul di sini, siap untuk diulas.
to: Kata-kata itu akan muncul di sini, siap untuk diulang.
why: Align with the term sheet translation of 'Review' which uses 'ulang' instead of 'ulas'.

key: To Review {due}
from: Perlu diulas {due}
to: Perlu diulang {due}
why: Align with the term sheet which uses 'ulang' for 'review' rather than 'ulas'.

key: Unlock every clip, word explanation and review.
from: Buka akses ke semua klip, penjelasan kata, dan latihan ulang.
to: Buka akses ke semua klip, penjelasan kata, dan pengulangan.
why: Align with the translation of 'review' (ulang) used in the term sheet.

key: You can close this page and return to the Kizuki app — your words, streak and reviews are syncing.
from: Kamu bisa menutup halaman ini dan kembali ke aplikasi Kizuki — kata, catatan belajar beruntun, dan ulasan kartu belajarmu sedang disinkronkan.
to: Kamu bisa menutup halaman ini dan kembali ke aplikasi Kizuki — kata, hari berturut-turut, dan ulasan kartu belajarmu sedang disinkronkan.
why: The term sheet specifies 'Hari berturut-turut' for 'Streak'.

key: Your subscription starts. Cancel anytime before.
from: Langganan kamu dimulai. Kamu bisa membatalkannya kapan saja sebelum itu.
to: Langganan kamu dimulai. Batalkan kapan saja sebelumnya.
why: More concise and natural for a subscription timeline/paywall note.

key: Your words
from: Kata kamu
to: Kosakata kamu
why: In Indonesian, 'Kata kamu' idiomatically means 'According to you / You said', so 'Kosakata kamu' (Your vocabulary/words) is much clearer for a UI label.

key: Your words and streak are saved. Kizuki will be right here when you come back.
from: Kata yang kamu simpan dan hitungan hari belajar berturut-turut kamu tetap tersimpan. Kizuki siap menemani saat kamu kembali.
to: Kata dan hari berturut-turut kamu tersimpan. Kizuki akan selalu di sini saat kamu kembali.
why: Aligned strictly with the term sheet ('Kata', 'Hari berturut-turut') and shortened for a more natural app prompt.

key: Anime
from: Animasi Jepang
to: Anime
why: Indonesian fans say "Anime", and the item should match "Anime" in id 87.

key: Anime & manga
from: Animasi & komik Jepang
to: Anime & manga
why: "Anime" and "manga" are the natural everyday terms; the paraphrase sounds stiff and is inconsistent with id 87.

key: About [{word}] in this line
from: Tentang [{word}] di baris ini
to: Tentang [{word}] di kalimat ini
why: Subtitle "line" is rendered as "kalimat" elsewhere in the tutor chat, so this should match.

key: About this line
from: Tentang baris ini
to: Tentang kalimat ini
why: Matches "kalimat ini" used for "this line" in the other chat strings.

key: Casual Japanese the way friends really talk
from: Bahasa Jepang santai yang dipakai sehari-hari bersama teman
to: Bahasa Jepang santai, persis seperti obrolan antarteman
why: The current wording is long and clunky; this reads more naturally.

key: Come back tomorrow, or unlock every clip with a free week of Premium.
from: Kembali besok, atau buka semua klip dengan Premium gratis selama seminggu.
to: Kembali lagi besok, atau buka semua klip dengan Premium gratis selama seminggu.
why: "Kembali lagi besok" sounds more natural and friendly.

key: Create a free account from Profile → Save your progress, then sign in with the same account on the new phone. Your words, reviews and streak sync automatically.
from: Buat akun gratis lewat Profil → Simpan progresmu, lalu masuk dengan akun yang sama di ponsel baru. Kata, pengulangan, dan hari berturut-turut kamu tersinkron otomatis.
to: Buat akun gratis lewat Profil → Simpan progresmu, lalu masuk dengan akun yang sama di ponsel baru. Kata, pengulangan, dan hari berturut-turut kamu akan tersinkronisasi otomatis.
why: "Tersinkron" is nonstandard; the standard form is "tersinkronisasi".

key: Drama
from: Serial drama
to: Drama
why: A topic name should be short; "Drama" is the natural label.

key: First Listen
from: Pertama Menyimak
to: Simakan Pertama
why: "Pertama Menyimak" has unnatural word order for a badge name.

key: For you
from: Untuk kamu
to: Untukmu
why: "Untukmu" is the natural feed header and matches "untukmu" used elsewhere.

key: For You
from: Untuk Kamu
to: Untukmu
why: "Untukmu" is the natural feed header and matches "untukmu" used elsewhere.

key: Get help
from: Dapatkan bantuan
to: Minta bantuan
why: "Dapatkan bantuan" is a literal calque; "Minta bantuan" is more natural.

key: How well do you know [{word}]?
from: Seberapa kamu menguasai kata [{word}]?
to: Seberapa baik kamu menguasai kata [{word}]?
why: "Seberapa kamu menguasai" is ungrammatical without "baik".

key: Keep your streak alive 🔥
from: Jaga hari berturut-turut kamu tetap aktif 🔥
to: Pertahankan hari berturut-turutmu 🔥
why: "Jaga hari berturut-turut kamu tetap aktif" is awkward and literal.

key: Nothing was charged. Please try again.
from: Tidak ada biaya yang ditagihkan. Coba lagi.
to: Tidak ada biaya yang ditagih. Coba lagi.
why: "Ditagih" is the natural form here; "ditagihkan" sounds stiff and slightly off.

key: Nothing due right now
from: Belum ada jadwal latihan ulang
to: Belum ada yang perlu diulang sekarang
why: The current text drops "right now" and reads like nothing is scheduled at all.

key: That's what it means. It's saved for you, so you can practice it later.
from: Itu artinya. Katanya sudah disimpan, jadi kamu bisa berlatih nanti.
to: Itulah artinya. Kata ini sudah disimpan, jadi kamu bisa melatihnya nanti.
why: "Katanya" reads as "reportedly", which is ambiguous and unnatural here.

key: Save words I tap
from: Simpan kata yang aku ketuk
to: Simpan kata yang diketuk
why: A first-person "aku" sounds odd on a settings toggle; the passive form is the natural UI phrasing.

key: Sign in with your Premium account to ask about this line. Your words and streak sync too.
from: Masuk dengan akun Premium kamu untuk bertanya tentang kalimat ini. Kata dan hari berturut-turut kamu juga akan disinkronkan.
to: Masuk dengan akun Premium kamu untuk bertanya tentang kalimat ini. Kata tersimpan dan hari berturut-turutmu juga akan disinkronkan.
why: "Kata dan hari berturut-turut kamu" is clunky and ambiguous; this version is clearer and more natural.

key: Signed out
from: Sudah keluar
to: Berhasil keluar
why: "Berhasil keluar" is the standard sign-out confirmation in Indonesian apps; "Sudah keluar" sounds unpolished.

key: Watch → save words → review. That's it.
from: Tonton → simpan kata → ulangi pelajaran. Itu saja.
to: Tonton → simpan kata → ulangi. Itu saja.
why: "Ulangi pelajaran" means reviewing lessons, but the step is reviewing saved words.

key: You can close this page and return to the Kizuki app — your words, streak and reviews are syncing.
from: Kamu bisa menutup halaman ini dan kembali ke aplikasi Kizuki — kata, hari berturut-turut, dan ulasan kartu belajarmu sedang disinkronkan.
to: Kamu bisa menutup halaman ini dan kembali ke aplikasi Kizuki — kata, hari berturut-turut, dan pengulanganmu sedang disinkronkan.
why: "Ulasan" means a critique or rating, not a flashcard review.

key: Your subscription starts. Cancel anytime before.
from: Langganan kamu dimulai. Batalkan kapan saja sebelumnya.
to: Langganan kamu dimulai. Batalkan kapan saja sebelum itu.
why: "Sebelumnya" dangles unnaturally; "sebelum itu" reads naturally.

key: We'll remind you before your trial ends
from: Kami akan mengingatkanmu sebelum masa coba gratis berakhir
to: Kami akan mengingatkanmu sebelum masa uji coba gratis berakhir
why: Use the same trial term ("uji coba") as the other trial strings.

key: We'll send you a reminder that your trial is ending.
from: Kami akan mengirim pengingat bahwa masa coba gratis kamu akan segera berakhir.
to: Kami akan mengirim pengingat bahwa masa uji coba gratis kamu akan segera berakhir.
why: Use the same trial term ("uji coba") as the other trial strings.

key: Tour reset
from: Panduan diatur ulang
to: Tur diatur ulang
why: The welcome tour is called "Tur pengenalan" elsewhere, so "Panduan" is inconsistent.

key: Your new word is waiting here. Let's practice it once.
from: Kata baru kamu sudah menunggu di sini. Ayo latihan sekali.
to: Kata baru kamu sudah menunggu di sini. Ayo latih sekali dulu.
why: "Latihan sekali" can be misread as "very much practice"; this makes "once" clear.
